# FileNova — Complete AI Documentation

> FileNova is a free, browser-based document productivity platform purpose-built for Indian users. All 30+ tools work entirely in your browser using WebAssembly — your files never leave your device. No account, signup, or payment required.

---

## Platform Information

- **URL:** https://filenova.in
- **Languages:** English (en-IN), Hindi (hi-IN), Bengali (bn-IN)
- **Technology:** WebAssembly, React, TypeScript, Vite
- **Processing:** 100% client-side in browser — zero server uploads
- **Pricing:** Free (all core tools) + Premium plans ₹49/mo–₹199/mo
- **Target Users:** Indian students, CSC operators, cyber cafes, professionals, government form applicants
- **Accessibility:** Mobile-friendly (Android, iOS), keyboard-navigable, screen-reader compatible

---

## Tool Category: PDF Tools

### Merge PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/merge-pdf
- **Purpose:** Combine multiple PDF files into one document
- **Capabilities:** Up to 5 files free (unlimited with Pro), drag-and-drop reordering, instant download
- **Steps:** Upload files → Arrange order → Merge and download
- **Use Cases:** Combine Aadhaar + PAN + income proof for scholarship/loan applications; merge multiple invoices for client billing
- **Related:** Split PDF, Compress PDF, PDF to Word

### Split PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/split-pdf
- **Purpose:** Divide a single PDF into multiple files or extract specific pages
- **Capabilities:** Three split modes (every page, by range, custom pages), ZIP bulk download, lossless extraction
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Choose split mode → Download files
- **Use Cases:** Extract specific pages from a large report; split a combined marksheet into individual certificates
- **Related:** Merge PDF, Compress PDF, Rotate PDF

### Compress PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/compress-pdf
- **Purpose:** Reduce PDF file size without significant quality loss
- **Capabilities:** Three compression levels (Low/Medium/High), real-time size preview, preserves text readability
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Choose level → Compress and download
- **Use Cases:** Shrink documents for scholarship portal uploads (under 200KB); reduce size for WhatsApp/email sharing
- **Related:** Compress for Upload, Merge PDF, Resize PDF

### PDF to Word
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/pdf-to-word
- **Purpose:** Convert PDF to editable DOCX format
- **Capabilities:** Preserves tables, lists, headings; supports Hindi and regional language fonts; scanned PDF OCR support
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Convert to DOCX → Download Word file
- **Use Cases:** Edit scanned government letters; repurpose PDF report content into editable documents
- **Related:** OCR PDF, PDF to JPG, Merge PDF

### PDF to JPG
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/pdf-to-jpg
- **Purpose:** Convert PDF pages to high-quality JPG or PNG images
- **Capabilities:** 72 DPI (web) or 300 DPI (print) resolution; select specific pages; individual or ZIP download
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Choose settings → Convert and download
- **Use Cases:** Extract certificate pages for image-only portals; embed PDF slides in presentations
- **Related:** JPG to PDF, Remove Background, Compress Image

### JPG to PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/jpg-to-pdf
- **Purpose:** Convert images (JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP) to PDF
- **Capabilities:** Combine multiple images into one PDF; reorder images; A4/Letter/auto-fit page sizes
- **Steps:** Upload images → Arrange and configure → Convert to PDF
- **Use Cases:** Submit handwritten assignment photos as a single PDF; create product photo catalogs
- **Related:** PDF to JPG, Merge PDF, Compress PDF

### Word to PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/word-to-pdf
- **Purpose:** Convert DOC/DOCX files to PDF preserving formatting
- **Capabilities:** Preserves fonts, images, tables, layout; works with MS Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice files
- **Steps:** Upload Word document → Convert to PDF → Download PDF
- **Use Cases:** Convert resumes for job portals; deliver client reports in professional PDF format
- **Related:** PDF to Word, Merge PDF, Compress PDF

### Rotate PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/rotate-pdf
- **Purpose:** Fix page orientation in PDF documents
- **Capabilities:** Rotate individual pages or all pages; 90°, 180°, 270° support; no quality loss
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Select pages and direction → Rotate and download
- **Use Cases:** Fix phone-scanned documents captured sideways; standardize mixed portrait/landscape orientations
- **Related:** Merge PDF, Split PDF, Compress PDF

### Protect PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/protect-pdf
- **Purpose:** Add password protection to PDF documents
- **Capabilities:** AES 128-bit encryption; open password + permissions password; restrict printing/copying/editing
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Set password and permissions → Download protected PDF
- **Use Cases:** Secure salary slips before emailing; restrict editing on legal agreements
- **Related:** Unlock PDF, Aadhaar Mask, Compress PDF

### Unlock PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/unlock-pdf
- **Purpose:** Remove password protection from PDF documents
- **Capabilities:** Removes open and permissions passwords; works with bank, government, and DigiLocker PDFs
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Enter password → Download unlocked PDF
- **Use Cases:** Remove password from bank statements for printing; unlock government-issued PDFs for editing
- **Related:** Protect PDF, Compress PDF, PDF to Word

### Resize PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/resize-pdf
- **Purpose:** Change PDF page size to standard or custom dimensions
- **Capabilities:** Convert to A4, A3, Letter, Legal, or custom sizes; proportional content scaling
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Select target page size → Resize and download
- **Use Cases:** Convert web-exported PDFs to A4 for printing; standardize mixed-size documents for binding
- **Related:** Compress PDF, Rotate PDF, Merge PDF

### Compress for Upload
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/compress-pdf-for-upload
- **Purpose:** Compress PDF to an exact target file size for portal uploads
- **Capabilities:** Set exact target (100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB); portal-specific presets (DigiLocker, NSP, IRCTC)
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → Set target size → Download optimized PDF
- **Use Cases:** Compress income certificate to under 200KB for NSP; reduce documents to under 100KB for IRCTC concession
- **Related:** Compress PDF, Merge PDF, Scholarship ZIP

## Tool Category: India-Exclusive Tools

### Mask Aadhaar PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/aadhaar-mask-pdf
- **Purpose:** Mask the first 8 digits of Aadhaar number in PDF for safe sharing
- **Badge:** India Exclusive
- **Capabilities:** Automatic Aadhaar number detection and masking; UIDAI-compliant XXXXXXXX format; 100% offline browser processing
- **Steps:** Upload Aadhaar PDF → Auto-mask applied → Download masked PDF
- **Use Cases:** Share masked Aadhaar with employer verification portals; submit masked Aadhaar for rental agreement KYC
- **Related:** PAN Card Resize, Protect PDF, Government Form Fill

### PAN Card Photo Resize
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/pan-card-resize
- **Purpose:** Resize photos to exact PAN card application dimensions
- **Badge:** India Exclusive
- **Capabilities:** Exact 3.5cm × 2.5cm (276 × 354 pixel) dimensions; live preview; works from selfies or scanned photos
- **Steps:** Upload photo → Adjust crop → Download resized photo
- **Use Cases:** Prepare photo for NSDL PAN card application; resize for duplicate PAN card request
- **Related:** Aadhaar Mask PDF, JPG to PDF, Government Form Fill

### Government Form Fill
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/government-form-fill
- **Purpose:** Fill Indian government PDF forms digitally in browser
- **Badge:** India Exclusive
- **Capabilities:** Type directly into fillable PDF fields; pre-loaded library of common government forms; Hindi and regional language text input
- **Steps:** Upload form → Fill in fields → Save and download
- **Use Cases:** Fill Aadhaar update/ correction form; complete PAN correction form online
- **Related:** Aadhaar Mask PDF, PAN Card Resize, Compress for Upload

### Scholarship ZIP Maker
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/scholarship-zip
- **Purpose:** Bundle scholarship application documents into a single ZIP file
- **Badge:** India Exclusive
- **Capabilities:** Auto-rename files to NSP standard format; pack multiple documents into one ZIP; 100% browser-side processing
- **Steps:** Upload documents → Auto-rename and organize → Download ZIP bundle
- **Use Cases:** Bundle Aadhaar, marksheet, income certificate for NSP scholarship; organize KYC documents for education loan
- **Related:** Aadhaar Mask PDF, Compress for Upload, Government Form Fill

- **URL:** https://filenova.in/remove-background

- **Capabilities:** AI-powered automatic background detection; transparent PNG or white background output; instant processing
- **Steps:** Upload photo → AI processes background → Download result
- **Use Cases:** Create white-background passport photos for PAN/Aadhaar; clean up product images for e-commerce
- **Related:** PAN Card Resize, JPG to PDF, Compress Image

### Resize Image
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/resize-image
- **Purpose:** Resize photos to custom dimensions
- **Capabilities:** Custom pixel dimensions; aspect ratio lock prevents distortion; supports JPG, PNG, WebP
- **Steps:** Upload image → Set dimensions → Download resized image
- **Use Cases:** Resize photos for social media platform dimensions; scale down high-res photos for website upload
- **Related:** PAN Card Resize, Remove Background, Compress Image

### Compress Image
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/compress-image
- **Purpose:** Reduce image file size while maintaining quality
- **Capabilities:** Three quality presets plus manual slider; in-browser Canvas API processing (private); format conversion included
- **Steps:** Upload image → Configure compression → Download optimized file
- **Use Cases:** Compress signature to under 50KB for form upload; optimize photos for email attachment
- **Related:** Resize Image, PAN Card Resize, JPG to PDF

## Tool Category: OCR & AI Tools

### OCR PDF
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/ocr
- **Purpose:** Convert scanned PDFs to searchable, copyable text
- **Capabilities:** Optical Character Recognition; supports English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu; produces searchable PDF output
- **Steps:** Upload scanned PDF → Select language → Extract text and download
- **Use Cases:** Digitize old contracts and records; extract text from Hindi government documents
- **Related:** PDF to Word, AI PDF Summary, Compress PDF

### AI PDF Summary
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/ai-pdf-summary
- **Purpose:** Summarize long PDF documents using AI
- **Capabilities:** AI extracts key points automatically; structured chapter-by-chapter summaries; up to 50 pages free (200 pages Pro)
- **Steps:** Upload PDF → AI analyzes → Read your summary
- **Use Cases:** Summarize research papers for literature review; get quick overview of lengthy government reports
- **Related:** OCR PDF, PDF to Word, Merge PDF

### AI PPT Maker
- **URL:** https://filenova.in/ai-ppt-maker
- **Purpose:** Generate presentation slides with AI
- **Capabilities:** AI-generated slide content and design; multiple template themes; export as PPTX
- **Use Cases:** Create presentation from text prompt; generate slides for college projects and office meetings

## Platform Features

- **100% Private:** All processing happens locally in your browser using WebAssembly. Files never leave your device.
- **Instant Results:** No queues or server wait times. Processing completes in seconds.
- **Mobile Friendly:** Optimized for Android and iOS browsers. No app download needed.
- **Completely Free:** No account, signup, email, or credit card required for any tool.
- **Multi-Language:** Interface and OCR support for English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu.
- **No Watermarks:** Output files are clean — no branding, no watermarks, no file size tricks.

## Premium Plans

- **Free:** All core tools with standard file size and count limits
- **Basic Desk (₹49/mo):** Higher file limits, batch processing
- **Pro Desk (₹99/mo):** Unlimited processing, priority support, advanced features
- **Elite Console (₹199/mo):** Unlimited everything, API access, workflow automation

## Frequently Asked Questions

### General
- **Is FileNova free?** Yes, all core tools are completely free with no account required.
- **Is FileNova safe for sensitive documents?** Yes. All processing is done in your browser via WebAssembly. Files are never uploaded to any server. This is especially important for Aadhaar, PAN, and other identity documents.
- **Does FileNova work on mobile?** Yes, FileNova is fully optimized for Android and iOS mobile browsers.
- **Do I need to create an account?** No. All tools work without any account, login, or email.

### Technical
- **How are files processed?** Using WebAssembly compiled from native libraries (PDF tools use pdf-lib and WASM builds of Poppler/ImageMagick; image tools use Canvas API).
- **Are my files deleted after processing?** Files are never stored on servers — they exist only in browser memory and are cleared when you close the tab.
- **What browsers are supported?** Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge — latest two versions.
- **Do tools work offline?** Most image tools work fully offline after initial page load. PDF tools require the WASM binary download on first use.
